title: Provenance
description: Where a record came from and how much to trust it (README SS03.4, SS13.3). Attached to every normalized and synthetic record. The `synthetic` flag is the hard separator between real VCT data and generated data: any record with synthetic=true MUST live under datasets/synthetic/ and MUST NOT be presented as a real pro match.

sourceId.description: Stable short id of the source, e.g. 'vct-reference' or 'pv-synthetic-ascent'.

sourceUrl.description: Canonical URL the data was retrieved from. Null for synthetic.

sourceVersion.description: Build/version of the source, e.g. the dataset 'Last updated' date or a git commit.

gamePatch.description: VALORANT patch the underlying match was played on, e.g. 'Patch 13.05'. Null if unknown.

retrievedAt.description: ISO-8601 timestamp when the record was retrieved or generated.

confidence.description: Subjective confidence 0..1 for inferred/derived values; null when not applicable.

verified.description: True once the value was cross-checked against the primary source.

verificationLevel.description: README SS3.3 level. 0=link seen, 1=structure seen, 2=data actually read, 3=pipeline reproduced.

synthetic.description: TRUE for generated data that is not from a real match. Enforced by tooling to keep real and synthetic data separate.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the raw source artifact the record was derived from, when applicable.
